class.name: VECSQueryBuilder
class.brief_description: A fluent, chainable query builder for the ECS world.
class.description:
[b]VECSQueryBuilder[/b] describes which entities to select. Every term method returns [code]this[/code] so calls can be chained, then one of the terminal methods runs the query:
[codeblock] var hits: Array = world.query() \ .with_all(["Position", "Velocity"]) \ .enabled() \ .execute() [/codeblock]
Query construction is cheap — matching is cached incrementally in the core, so repeated queries cost little. Obtain a builder from [method VECSWorld.query].

method.name: changed
method.description: Restricts the query to entities whose named components were written since the previous execution of a query with the same membership and changed set. The baseline is tracked per query, so filters do not interfere. Ideal for sparse, event-driven systems.

method.name: count
method.description: Returns the number of matching entities without materializing them.

method.name: enabled
method.description: Restricts the query to entities whose enabled flag is set (via [method VECSSystem]-independent entity enable/disable state).

method.name: execute
method.description: Runs the query and returns an [Array] of matching [VECSEntity] handles. For large result sets consider [method VECSWorld.each] to avoid materializing the array.

method.name: execute_one
method.description: Runs the query and returns the first matching entity (or a null handle if none match). Honors the same filters as [method execute], including [method changed].

method.name: with_all
method.description: Requires the entity to have every component named in [param names]. Unknown names are ignored with an error printed.

method.name: with_any
method.description: Requires the entity to have at least one of the components named in [param names].

method.name: with_none
method.description: Requires the entity to have none of the components named in [param names].
